title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 07:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 07:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z) at 07:00 UTC. The 07:00 hour is now complete (60 samples through 07:59; end-of-hour 0.33/0P). 08:00 UTC is a trailing incomplete hour (only 16 samples to 08:15), so it is not used. Last-180 maximum 1.00 first at 05:16 UTC on 21 September (label 1Z; last-180 window from 05:16 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.67 (02:34 UTC, label 2M). Window start 02:17 UTC on 21 September (359 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新可靠整點估計 Kp = 0.00（標籤 0Z；07:00 UTC）。07:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 07:59，時段末 0.33／0P）。08:00 UTC 為未收滿時段（至 08:15 僅 16 筆），故不採用。近 180 筆最大 1.00（最先見於 2026-09-21 05:16 UTC；標籤 1Z；近 180 筆窗自 05:16 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.67（02:34 UTC；標籤 2M）。窗起點 2026-09-21 02:17 UTC（359 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (07:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 07:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the trailing 08:00 hour is incomplete and unused.

title.en: A magnitude 5.0 earthquake occurred 34 km WNW of Luwuk, Indonesia on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日，印尼 Luwuk 西北西約 34 公里發生規模 5.0 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.0, depth about 9.9 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum is mww 6.4 (us7000tiqc, Papua New Guinea).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.0，深度約 9.9 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 6.4（us7000tiqc，巴布亞紐幾內亞）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
